title: Advanced Potato Growth Symbols
purpose: Keep advanced aspirational identities separate from the two root principles so the path remains simple while still supporting richer symbolic development.

symbols.name: Angel
symbols.meaning: A person or aspect of self whose greater capability is paired with greater truthfulness, care, protection, mercy, discernment and service.
symbols.historical_note: Angel derives from messenger language in Greek and biblical traditions; the Potatoist use is a symbolic extension, not a claim of literal supernatural transformation.

symbols.name: Valkyrie
symbols.meaning: A figure of courage, discernment under pressure, protection and carrying hard-earned wisdom forward after ordeal.
symbols.historical_note: Historical Norse valkyries belong to a distinct mythic tradition associated with Odin; Potatoism uses the image comparatively rather than claiming historical identity.

symbols.name: Gardener
symbols.meaning: Improve the soil, relationships, tools and conditions in which life can grow instead of attempting to control every outcome directly.

symbols.name: Seed-maker
symbols.meaning: Simplify and distribute what has been learned so another person or future cycle can begin without depending on constant central control.

rule: Higher symbolic identities are valid only when they produce better conduct and better conditions for life; titles do not substitute for fruit.
